notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's 35 precinct sample ballots. Issue wording is from the sample ballots.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
Wyandot County's ballots do not number local issues (only statewide Issue 3 is numbered); see your sample ballot for the order of the issues.

The state voter file does not separate Sycamore Village from Sycamore Township; Sycamore Village voters should use Sycamore Township here, but do not vote on the electric aggregation question (unincorporated areas only).
